parameters.prompt: Original instrumental underscore for a contemporary mature werewolf romance, intimate and restrained rather than epic or horror. D minor, 60 BPM, 4/4. Shared recurring four-note leitmotif D-F-E-A with spacious rests, one quiet statement every four bars. Low cello, sparse felt piano, delicate electronic pulse; leave room for a low male speaking voice. Clean studio music only: no voices, breathing, choir, environmental sound, risers or impacts. A seamless 9-bar 36-second bed. Sparse low sustained strings, very quiet soft rounded electronic pulses, minimal felt piano playing the motif. Suspended attraction and self-control, dignified midnight city tension. Stable instrumentation and dynamics throughout, no intro, no outro, no big ending; sustain continuous texture through boundaries.
